hero.title: Personal support, corporate analytics and scientific forecasting in one system
hero.subtitle: Dzvin.co helps identify stress, burnout and behavioral risk before they escalate into critical outcomes. The platform combines personal state tracking, team stability analytics, and research-grade forecasting models built on behavioral dynamics and uncertainty.
hero.note: All charts below are illustrative examples based on existing product capabilities, not live customer data.

blueprint.title: Three service tracks of one platform
blueprint.subtitle: The platform works as a personal service for users, an analytics service for companies, and a validation service for programs and research. Below is how its role changes across these three scenarios.

personalFlow.title: Personal support track
personalFlow.description: For individuals, the service combines daily observations, exercises and tailored recommendations into one coherent action path.
personalFlow.focus: Focus: continuous personal support, short feedback loops and visible progress.

corporateFlow.title: Corporate operations track
corporateFlow.description: For companies, the service combines roles, groups, team analytics and risk signals into one manageable operating model.
corporateFlow.focus: Focus: aggregated team visibility, scoped access and timely management action.

researchFlow.title: Research validation track
researchFlow.description: For research programs, institutes and universities, the service connects cohorts, outcome measurement and evidence accumulation to validate hypotheses.
researchFlow.focus: Focus: impact validation, repeatable observations and accountable program reporting.

b2c.title: For individuals
b2c.description: The personal service gathers state signals, offers simple practices and helps reveal what actually supports mental well-being in everyday use.

serviceSummaryItems.tracking: Brings state signals into one sequence.
serviceSummaryItems.support: Suggests a relevant practice right after self-check.
serviceSummaryItems.consistency: Keeps change history easy to revisit.

resultSummaryItems.one: State becomes easier to understand over time.
resultSummaryItems.two: The next step is clear right after assessment.
resultSummaryItems.three: Support turns into a path that is easy to continue every day.

one.title: Separate signals without a shared picture
one.description: Mood, short notes and self-checks existed separately, so it was difficult to see change as one continuous process.

two.title: Practices were not linked to the moment
two.description: Helpful exercises or advice could exist on their own, but they did not appear at the exact moment they were most relevant.

three.title: Results did not accumulate in one story
three.description: Even when something helped, it did not turn into a support path people could quickly return to.

tracking.title: State is captured in one place
tracking.description: Mood, short notes and questionnaires are gathered into one sequence that shows frequency of change, recurring triggers and movement across days.

support.title: A practice appears right after assessment
support.description: After a self-check, the service immediately opens breathing, meditation, an exercise or short guidance connected to the current state.

consistency.title: Effective routines are easy to repeat
consistency.description: Saved exercises, materials and state history stay available so people can repeat what has already produced a visible result.

one.title: State becomes clearer over time
one.description: Instead of isolated episodes, there is a fuller picture of how well-being changes across days and weeks.

two.title: The next step becomes concrete
two.description: After assessment, there is not just abstract advice but a specific action that can be taken immediately.

three.title: Support becomes cumulative
three.description: Helpful practices and visible progress stop getting lost and start forming a path that is easier to continue.

outcomes.one: A better sense of your state and less confusion about what is happening to you.
outcomes.two: Simple daily steps that help you feel more grounded and calm.
outcomes.three: A clearer view of what works for you personally and how your state changes over time.

b2b.title: For companies
b2b.description: The B2B layer turns team state signals into an early-response operating system: leaders and HR get an aggregated risk view, see where teams are losing energy, and can act before the issue becomes burnout, attrition or a visible performance drag.
b2b.managerTitle: What a manager sees and controls

governance.title: Org structure, roles and accountability zones
governance.description: The platform brings teams, roles, groups and access scopes into one managed layer so managers can see the right slice of the organization without permission chaos, manual reporting merges or endless clarification loops.

analytics.title: State dynamics across teams and groups
analytics.description: Instead of stitching together fragmented signals, managers get one analytical surface for stress, energy, focus and mood trends, making it easier to spot which teams need attention right now.

decisionSupport.title: Action priorities and support control
decisionSupport.description: The system highlights critical risk zones, helps identify where intervention will have the biggest payoff, and moves management action from intuition-led to evidence-led.

one.title: One management surface for team well-being
one.description: Leadership gets a transparent aggregated view of team state without exposing private stories, which makes well-being manageable as an operating discipline rather than a reactive afterthought.

two.title: Faster decisions with measurable operational payoff
two.description: When risk becomes visible earlier, companies can prioritize support faster, direct manager attention with more precision, and reduce losses from burnout, attrition and performance decline.

three.title: A stronger case for HR and executive buy-in
three.description: Data dynamics move the conversation from ‘well-being matters’ to ‘here is where the business is already losing capacity and where support creates measurable return’, making leadership alignment easier to secure.

outcomes.one: One management view of team well-being without exposing personal histories.
outcomes.two: Faster decisions about support, manager priorities and focus teams.
outcomes.three: Arguments for HR and leadership backed by data dynamics, not just intuition.

rd.title: For researchers, institutes and universities
rd.description: The R&D layer turns the platform into a research environment: standardized self-checks, behavioral signals, cohort analysis, prediction validation and outcome tracking in one system.

cohorts.title: Build comparable cohorts
cohorts.description: Unified collection instruments make it possible to build cohorts, compare subgroups and repeat an observation design across collection waves.

validation.title: Validate predictions
validation.description: The prediction-to-outcome loop shows model accuracy, drift and change after intervention at the cohort or program level.

reporting.title: Report impact
reporting.description: Data can be turned into material for reports, ethics packages, grant applications and communication with organizations that finance research.

one.title: Collect standardized observations
one.description: We work with the same scales, behavioral signals and controlled data collection flows so results remain comparable.

two.title: Build cohorts and analytical cuts
two.description: Participants can be segmented by state patterns, risk, intervention response and observation windows.

three.title: Validate predictions against outcomes
three.description: We show where the model was accurate, where drift appeared and what effect was actually observed after intervention.

one.title: Repeatable measurement logic
one.description: The same measurement logic works in the everyday product and in the research layer, so data does not break across environments.

two.title: Visible drift and accuracy
two.description: Teams can monitor how prediction quality changes over time and whether a model stays valid on new samples.

three.title: Evidence for papers and grants
three.description: Cohort comparisons, intervention dynamics and program outcomes accumulate into material that can support a publication or grant proposal.

one.title: Reduce time to a working study design
one.description: Teams do not start from zero: the digital loop for data collection, cohort analysis and outcome capture is already in place.

two.title: Provide structure for reports and papers
two.description: Researchers get more than raw signals and can work with a structure that supports analysis, conclusions and accountable reporting.

three.title: Strengthen grant reasoning
three.description: We help explain what is measured, how effect is validated and why the approach is practically valuable for a research team or grant provider.

one.title: Standardized inputs
one.description: Cohorts are built from the same self-checks, behavioral signals and questionnaires the platform already uses day to day.

two.title: Hypotheses checked against outcomes
two.description: The prediction-to-outcome loop shows model accuracy, drift and intervention effect instead of leaving the program at an intermediate signal.

three.title: An accountable evidence package
three.description: Aggregated trends, cohort comparisons and program results accumulate into an evidence base institutes, universities and research teams can actually use.

outcomes.one: A population-level view built from the same modules people use every day.
outcomes.two: An accumulating evidence base that confirms or refutes each program hypothesis.
outcomes.three: A path from intervention delivery to accountable outcome reporting.
